item.title: 7-Zip 26.02 Fixes XZ Parsing RCE Vulnerability
item.content:encoded:
Update now: 7-Zip fixes RCE flaw exploitable with malicious archives — Must Read

7-Zip 26.02 fixes a remote code execution flaw in its XZ decompression handling that could be triggered by a malicious archive. Because 7-Zip does not auto-update, users should manually install the latest version from the official site.

  • 7-Zip version 26.02 was released to fix a remote code execution vulnerability in the program’s processing of XZ-compressed data.
  • The Zero Day Initiative advisory says specially crafted XZ data can trigger a heap-based buffer overflow that may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code as the user.
  • Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious page or opening a malicious archive file.
  • 7-Zip does not include an automatic update feature, so users must manually download and install the latest version from 7-zip.org.
  • There are currently no reports that attackers are actively exploiting this newly disclosed 7-Zip vulnerability.
